title: Create introduction pages for "Guide" "Components" "Connectors"
body:
Right now:
- click Guide => Styling is shown
- click Components => Hits is shown
- click Connectors => connectHits is shown

This can misleading and surprising, we would be better having some introduction page explaining what are the goals and use of each section.

"In this guide you will learn about beginner and advanced concepts and use case.."

"Widgets are our pre-styled pre-connected search widgets..., difference with connectors, when to use a widget, how to use a widget"

"Connectors are HOC, when to use a connector, differences wit widgets.., how to use a connector"

Those small draft are just ideas, we do not need to be very descriptive but at least we need them
